title: delphinium peregrinum var. elongatum
intro: Delphinium peregrinum var. elongatum, commonly known as Monk's Hood or Delphinium, is a plant species within the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae) that is native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, helping to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Delphinium peregrinum var. elongatum include its ability to stimulate the nervous system, induce sedation, and act as a purgative. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, such as delphinine and aconitine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
